env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
# In a marked module plain go re-executes and denies cgo, like logos.
[cgo] ! go build -o $WORK/plain$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
[cgo] ! logos build -o $WORK/logos$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

# A module without logos.toml keeps plain go: cgo builds.
cd plain
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] go build -o $WORK/plain-unmarked$GOEXE ./sub
cd ..

# Unset observes the upstream default (1 where cgo is available).
env CGO_ENABLED=
[cgo] go env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^1$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/plaincgo

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- marker.lgo --
package marker

-- sub/main.go --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

func main() { _ = C.answer() }

-- plain/go.mod --
module example.com/plaincgo-unmarked

go 1.27

-- plain/sub/main.go --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

func main() { _ = C.answer() }
